scripts.dev: node init && APP_ENV=non-prod NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV=non-prod NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE=demo concurrently -k -n api,web -c gray,white "npm run dev -w @musica/api" "npm run dev -w @musica/web"
scripts.dev:firebase: node init && API_PORT=4001 API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4001 node --env-file=config/non-prod.env.example node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n emulator,api,web -c yellow,gray,white "firebase emulators:start --project demo-musica-non-prod --only auth,firestore,storage" "npm run dev:firebase -w @musica/api" "npm run dev -w @musica/web -- --port 3001"
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w @musica/api && npm run build -w @musica/web
scripts.test:firebase: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-musica-non-prod --only auth,firestore,storage "npm run test:emulator -w @musica/api && node --test firebase/tests/rules.test.mjs"
